description: Integrate NEW_HOMEPAGE landing page into the existing Next.js app, wiring CoursesSection to live Convex backend data with static price/duration/image config

userStories.title: Copy homepage components and assets into app structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all NEW_HOMEPAGE components moved into the correct Next.js app directories so they can be used by the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Copy NEW_HOMEPAGE/src/app/components/ → app/components/homepage/ (all files: Header.tsx, HeroSection.tsx, AboutUsSection.tsx, CoursesSection.tsx, Footer.tsx, ResponsiveLanding.tsx, figma/, ui/)
Copy NEW_HOMEPAGE/src/app/contexts/LanguageContext.tsx → app/contexts/LanguageContext.tsx
Copy NEW_HOMEPAGE/src/app/i18n/translations.ts → app/i18n/translations.ts
Copy NEW_HOMEPAGE/src/imports/ (SVG path files) → app/components/homepage/imports/
Copy NEW_HOMEPAGE/src/assets/*.png → public/images/homepage/
Replace all 'figma:asset/<hash>.png' import paths in components with '/images/homepage/<hash>.png' (use direct URL strings, not imports)
Update all import paths inside the copied components to use the new relative paths
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Source is NEW_HOMEPAGE/ directory at repo root. Target is the existing Next.js app. The figma:asset imports like 'figma:asset/30c657383d224670b9671a2f703069965543dc7c.png' should become src='/images/homepage/30c657383d224670b9671a2f703069965543dc7c.png' as img src attributes or Next.js Image src props. The ImageWithFallback component in figma/ subfolder handles this. Update it to use a standard img tag or next/image with a string path.

userStories.title: Replace app/page.tsx with new ResponsiveLanding homepage
userStories.description: As a developer, I want app/page.tsx to render the new landing page and app/homepage-client.tsx to be removed.
acceptanceCriteria: app/page.tsx renders <ResponsiveLanding /> wrapped in <LanguageProvider>
app/homepage-client.tsx is deleted
LanguageContext provider wraps the page so useLanguage() works in all child components
Install any missing npm packages required by the new components (check package.json in NEW_HOMEPAGE/ vs root)
npm run build passes with no errors
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Check NEW_HOMEPAGE/package.json for dependencies not in root package.json. Key ones likely needed: class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge, lucide-react, @radix-ui/* (many). Add them to root package.json and run npm install. The LanguageProvider is exported from app/contexts/LanguageContext.tsx.

userStories.title: Create courseConfig.ts with static price/duration/image per class_id
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a typed config file that maps class_id to static display fields so CoursesSection can look up price, duration, and image without hitting the DB.
acceptanceCriteria: Create app/i18n/courseConfig.ts
Export COURSE_CONFIG: Record<string, { duration: string; originalPrice: string; discountPrice: string; image: string; }> where image is a path under /images/homepage/
Include entries for class_id 'class_cycling_fundamentals' (duration: '2 hours', originalPrice: 'HK$560', discountPrice: 'HK$400', image matching the cycling beginner image)
Include entries for class_id 'class_city_guided_tour' (duration: '3 hours', originalPrice: 'HK$650', discountPrice: 'HK$550', image matching the tours image)
Export a helper getCourseConfig(class_id: string) that returns the config or undefined if not found
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The class_id values come from convex/seed.ts: 'class_cycling_fundamentals' and 'class_city_guided_tour'. Images are the .png files copied to public/images/homepage/. Match them by looking at the CoursesSection hardcoded order: course1=beginner, course2=improvement, course3=tours. Use the actual hash filenames from NEW_HOMEPAGE/src/assets/.

userStories.title: Wire CoursesSection to live backend data via /api/classes and /api/sessions
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to see real classes and their upcoming sessions on the homepage so I can find and enroll in a class.
acceptanceCriteria: CoursesSection fetches active classes from GET /api/classes on mount
For each class, fetches sessions from GET /api/sessions?class_id=<id>
Maps quota_available === 0 to isFull: true on each session
Maps session fields: date, time, location, isFull → ClassSchedule interface
Looks up static config from getCourseConfig(class_id) for duration, originalPrice, discountPrice, image
Skips classes with no entry in courseConfig (getCourseConfig returns undefined)
Course title and description come from the backend (class.name and class.description), not translations
Shows a loading skeleton while fetching (at least 2 placeholder cards)
Shows 'No upcoming classes' message if classes array is empty after fetch
Enroll button/link uses payment_url from the backend for each class
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: The existing API routes are at app/api/classes/route.ts and app/api/sessions/route.ts. Check they return the right shape. CoursesSection is now at app/components/homepage/CoursesSection.tsx. Use React useState + useEffect or SWR for data fetching — keep it simple, no server components needed here. The ClassSchedule interface is already defined in CoursesSection.tsx.

userStories.title: Add unit and integration tests for CoursesSection and courseConfig
userStories.description: As a developer, I want tests covering the course config lookup and CoursesSection rendering so regressions are caught.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit test: getCourseConfig('class_cycling_fundamentals') returns correct duration, price, image
Unit test: getCourseConfig('unknown_class') returns undefined
Unit test: session with quota_available=0 maps to isFull=true
Unit test: session with quota_available=3 maps to isFull=false
Integration test: CoursesSection renders course cards when API returns data (mock fetch)
Integration test: CoursesSection shows 'FULL' badge on sessions with quota_available=0
Integration test: CoursesSection shows loading state while fetch is pending
Integration test: CoursesSection skips classes not in courseConfig
All tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use the existing test framework in the project (check package.json for jest/vitest/playwright). Tests go in tests/ directory following existing pattern. For CoursesSection integration tests, use React Testing Library with mocked fetch. For unit tests, import getCourseConfig and test directly.
